# Opal

> Opal is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0), local-first desktop media player for Linux, macOS and Windows (alpha). One app searches and plays movies, TV, anime, live TV/IPTV, YouTube, torrents and manga — plus existing Jellyfin and Plex libraries — with an on-device AI copilot, no account and no telemetry.

Opal ships with no content sources enabled and hosts no content.

## Pages

- [Home](https://opal.palash.dev/): overview, screenshots and downloads
- [Features](https://opal.palash.dev/features/): universal search, torrent streaming, live TV, manga, local AI
- [Keyless Movies and TV guide](https://opal.palash.dev/guides/keyless-movies-tv/): browse, search, seasons and episodes without a TMDB key
- [Compare](https://opal.palash.dev/compare/): capability matrix vs Jellyfin, Plex, Stremio, Kodi and qBittorrent
- [Opal vs Jellyfin](https://opal.palash.dev/compare/jellyfin/)
- [Opal vs Plex](https://opal.palash.dev/compare/plex/)
- [Opal vs Stremio](https://opal.palash.dev/compare/stremio/)
- [Opal vs Kodi](https://opal.palash.dev/compare/kodi/)
- [Opal vs qBittorrent](https://opal.palash.dev/compare/qbittorrent/)
- [Opal Connect extension](https://opal.palash.dev/extension/): browser extension for Chrome, Edge and Firefox
- [Download](https://opal.palash.dev/download/): AppImage, DEB, RPM, DMG, MSI and portable builds
- [Changelog](https://opal.palash.dev/changelog/): release notes and version history
- [FAQ](https://opal.palash.dev/faq/)
- [Privacy](https://opal.palash.dev/privacy/)
